reviews.text: Fantastic experience! Dr. Cauteruccio cared for my two-month-old kitten with immense professionalism and expertise. She's incredibly talented, very knowledgeable, and her passion for animals is evident at first glance. I immediately felt at ease, and the kitten was also very calm throughout. A warm and trustworthy veterinarian, I recommend her to anyone!

We came to Dr. Maria in despair because our beloved ginger cat, Atena, also known as Queen Weasel, was exhausted. After months of suffering from dermatitis all over her body, she had started vomiting and producing blood in her stool. After years of these constant problems, without any doctor ever being able to truly help us, we finally met the doctor, who courageously took on such a complex case as ours. Her experience and professionalism immediately pinpointed the problem; I couldn't believe it. Finally, they were addressing the causes, not just the symptoms. After various tests and examinations (with Atena going from a weasel to a tiger, which the doctor handled brilliantly) we got to the root of it all. Throughout the process, we felt listened to, understood, believed, and supported. Now Atena is healing, she's doing much better, and so are we. Thank you, Doc.
Your empathy, your knowledge, and your professionalism are rare commodities! ❤️
A very competent doctor who loves her job and animals. Now I have a new office, better equipped, always at the top.

Dr. Cauteruccio is the best and most helpful doctor in the Vomero area and surrounding areas.
I highly recommend her ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I called this morning for an emergency, they didn't answer, I won't express myself who you are

We are delighted to have Maria Cauteruccio of Omodeo Veterinary Clinic as our doctor.
She was excellent at finding and explaining our cat's diagnosis and performed the procedures professionally.
During our visits with the doctor, we definitely noticed her love for animals and their owners.
She is humane, kind, competent, and experienced, with just the right amount of playfulness.
If you're looking for a good vet, I recommend Maria Cauteruccio!

I had a wonderful time at this veterinary clinic, which I found by chance because we recently moved to the area. The doctor is extremely empathetic, meticulous, and attentive: she took care of my dog ​​with great professionalism and is following her every step of the way, always with a humane and reassuring approach.
The clinic is spotless and organized, and the doctor immediately inspires trust.
A place where you can sense ethics, competence, and a sincere dedication to animals.
I would recommend it without a doubt.

Excellent veterinary practice with genuinely caring vets. Dott. Cauteruccio is incredibly thorough and attentive, always taking the time to help make our anxious dog feel more comfortable during visits. Dott. Marchionne is equally wonderful—empathetic, professional, and reassuring. We always feel our dog is in the best hands. Highly recommended!

We've been going to the Omodeo clinic for years now, where Dr. Cauteruccio treats Leo with great expertise, professionalism, and an uncommon level of empathy that immediately made us feel welcome and safe. I can't recommend it highly enough.
Professional, competent, and kind. With a touch of kindness, which never hurts. After the operation, the kitten recovered quickly and is more lively than ever. Thank you.

Dr. Maria Cauteruccio is a rare professional, one you rarely encounter in life.
She cared for Colibrì with a kindness and dedication that went far beyond the call of duty. Her availability is extraordinary: always present, at any hour, even in the most critical moments, with a kindness and professionalism that truly make a difference.

She is empathetic, attentive, capable of listening and gently supporting both animals and their owners. Such humanity is not a given these days.
She combines expertise, sensitivity, and a big heart: she knows how to reassure with words and intervene with actions, never failing to offer her support.

She never left me alone, not even in the most difficult moments, and this meant everything to me.
Colibrì couldn't have had a better veterinarian.
And I couldn't have met a more special person.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Doctor, for everything you have done and continue to do.
I will always be grateful.

Dear Dr. Cauteruccio,
I dedicate this thought to you because I want to thank you publicly and sincerely. Your unquestionable medical expertise and extraordinary professionalism, combined with a rare kindness and sensitivity, are a fundamental point of reference for me.
You always know how to support and reassure us owners in times of anxiety. Finding a doctor who combines top-notch training with such a big heart truly makes a difference.
Thank you for caring for Kelli with immense love, and thank you for listening and supporting me as well. Having a person and a professional like you by my side is a true privilege.
Highly recommended!
With deepest respect, Giuliana

One of the best vets I've ever dealt with. I wish I'd known about her sooner...

One of the best vets I've ever dealt with. It's a shame I can't go back in time to take my pets to her sooner...
our little cookie relies on the doctor as a child
You couldn't trust your pets to better hands! In this clinic, you'll find great professionalism and expertise, but above all, a lot of attention and empathy.

I took Mia, my 9-year-old dog, to Dr. Maria with great anxiety: Mia has a difficult personality and is very fearful. However, for the first time, I was able to relax thanks to the kindness and professionalism of the doctor and her team!
Dr. Maria, Dr. Marchionne, and Dr. Marra in particular were impeccable: with rare expertise and extraordinary empathy, they managed to examine her thoroughly despite her resistance. A humane, professional, and not at all venal team.
I recommend them to everyone, even the most reluctant furry friends!

I came to this veterinary clinic based on the very positive reviews, which after my own experience I can only wholeheartedly confirm. The doctor is extremely knowledgeable, clear, precise, and up-to-date. Her top priority is the patient's overall well-being.
I met her when I brought my beloved dog to her, and we will definitely return for our cats as well.
I also believe that from a financial standpoint, she is extremely fair, correct, and transparent.
We took our dog Margot to the clinic and there was a very good, professional and kind doctor who took care of our little girl.
Dr. Cauteruccio is an exceptional professional who, always available, takes care of Bruno, our furry baby, with competence and tenderness.

An exceptional professional who has been caring for our puppy since he arrived home. Extremely competent, professional, and attentive to everything. Furthermore, she always provides detailed explanations and is extremely helpful.

My beloved dogs have always been entrusted to Dr. Maria's care. She's knowledgeable, attentive, professional, and always available. She loves her job, and it shows. A truly sweet doctor. Thank you from us.

The doctor welcomed me with unparalleled kindness and gentleness. She explained a lot to me, gave me tips and advice, performed a very thorough examination, and was generally extremely helpful and knowledgeable.

Courtesy, professionalism, and expertise characterize this veterinary clinic. Furthermore, Dr. Maria's friendliness and kindness make her a point of reference for me. Highly recommended.

My puppy, Kevin, is a patient of Dr. Maria, who, besides being extremely professional, is also very kind, helpful, and above all trustworthy. From the very first moment, she treated me and my dog ​​with the utmost care and kindness. I couldn't have chosen a better veterinarian for my Kevin.

Excellent!

Ten days have passed, and Silvestro is doing much better; the critical phase has passed. He is still on dietary and probiotic therapy. I was fortunate to find competent, professional, and kind people. 100,000 stars for this veterinary center, which is extremely clean. Thank you.

Dr. Cauteruccio has now become our go-to person, with immense empathy and professionalism.

Thank you.

Dr. Cauteruccio is always available and attentive to her patients' needs, and very empathetic with us, the owners.

The very professional and empathetic doctor is helping me with my puppy Maya. I highly recommend her.

I met Dr. Maria by pure chance, and to be honest, I was truly blessed from day one. She was there for me during the difficult times I had with my poodle. She's a person who has never abandoned us over these months, always available whenever I needed her. What can I say? She's exceptional, both as a doctor and as a person. Thanks to her, my poodle is doing well, and to be honest, it's a miracle.

In conclusion, I wouldn't change her for anything in the world.

I needed to contact Dr. Renato Marchionne's veterinary clinic, located near my home, because my dog ​​wasn't feeling well. I found the most competent and empathetic veterinarian I'd previously consulted, Dr. Maria Cautariello. She is lovingly caring for my furry friend, and I see her improving day by day.
The Omodeo clinic employs excellent professionals, and the animal is cared for in a comfortable and well-organized environment. Thank you, Dr. Maria, also for the psychological support you gave me at a time when I thought I was losing my little girl.

Yesterday we took our 4-month-old pinscher, Coco, to the Omodeo Veterinary Clinic, where he was examined by the wonderful Dr. Maria Cauteruccio. What can I say? She was incredibly attentive and kind; you can tell she truly loves her job! The clinic is welcoming, clean, and well-organized, and the staff is incredibly helpful and friendly. Coco, despite it being his first visit, felt at ease thanks to the doctor's kindness and sensitivity. We're truly happy with the experience and recommend this place to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friends!

The veterinary clinic on Via Omodeo in Naples is very well equipped, offering a wide range of clinical tests and various therapies.
Dr. Maria Cauteruccio is extremely competent and skilled.

I'm extremely satisfied with the service I received from the veterinarian, a truly exceptional professional. Beyond her technical expertise, what struck me most was her loving and dedicated approach to animals. Every time I brought my dog, I always saw her interact with kindness and patience, putting the animal at ease and reassuring us, the owners, as well. She doesn't just do her job, she does it with passion, carefully listening to our every concern and responding with expertise and availability. Her empathy and commitment are truly unique, and it's clear how much she cares about the well-being of the animals she sees. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a high-quality veterinarian, and above all, one with a big heart!

By following all the advice she gives me, my puppy is in excellent health and is growing up wonderfully!
Thank you for everything, Doctor. Hugs from me and Choco.
